_: The PLAYER's four approach lines - the menu options themselves. The line bank in lines.json is NPC-side only; N-5 left the player's half open and XDI settled it (O-3), so these are new and need the owner's eye like any other line. They are UNVOICED by design: XDI presents them as text and keeps the camera off the player's still face.
_slots: Slot per O-4, tone-faithful: charm=PTOP positive, offer=NETO neutral, blunt=NTOP negative, linger=QTOP question. NTOP is NEGATIVE and NETO NEUTRAL - measured through XDI's optionIDs, and named so by xEdit ('Player Negative Response', 'Player Neutral Response').
_fields: text = the menu PROMPT (the INFO's RNAM). spoken = what the player then SAYS (the INFO's NAM1). That is the player's line and never the NPC's: the NPC answers from its own topic (NPOT/NNGT/NNUT/NQUT). spoken defaults to text when absent.

prompts.note: Material. Deliberately flat - the point is the thing, not the words.

variants.text: Here. Found this and thought of you.
This is for you. No strings.
I picked something up for you on the road.
Take it. I saved it for you.

prompts.text: Nobody out here looks at you properly, do they.
prompts.note: Flattery that costs the speaker something to say. Not a compliment on appearance - a claim to have noticed them.

variants.text: You're the only one here who still looks people in the eye.
I notice you. I don't think anyone else here does.
Most people out here stopped seeing each other. I haven't stopped seeing you.
You carry this place and nobody thanks you for it.

prompts.text: I want to fuck you. Here, against that wall, I don't care.
prompts.note: Owner asked for harder. It names the act and a place, which also sets up the public recoil: the vulgar NPC wants it and still does not want it in front of the whole settlement. If this reads as coy the register is broken (O-6).

variants.text: I want you bent over something, and I want it now.
Get on your knees for me. Right here, right now.
I want you on top of me, riding me until you can't breathe.
I want you on your back with your legs wrapped around me.

prompts.note: Parenthesised because the player does not speak it, so spoken is empty. The only option whose content is an absence, which is why it sits in the question slot.

variants.text: (Say nothing. Hold their gaze.)
(Stay quiet. Don't leave.)
(Lean on the wall beside them and wait.)
(Stay close, and let them speak first.)

Stage 3 is the proposition phrased in each register: only the persona's own register gets a verdict, the other three are refused (unless the NPC is the player's lover: O-31).

_variants: O-46 (owner, 2026-09-25: 'why i have always the same propositions lines'): each option has five versions, the line itself and 'variants'. Overture rolls OverturePlayerVariant 0-4 once as a conversation opens; version k shows when it is k. A variant keeps its option's job, because NPC answers are written against it (offer = a gift or caps, stage-2 charm = coming by, stage-3 offer = a price). The owner approved every text.
